acceptedAnswer.text: Consultations are handled confidentially within professional and legal boundaries. Limits can apply when there is an immediate safety risk or when disclosure is required by law. Ask the clinic if you want to understand how a specific situation is handled.

mainEntity.name: Who will have access to my records?

acceptedAnswer.text: Access is limited to the clinician and staff who need information for care or appointment administration. Information may also be shared where you have consented or where disclosure is required by law.

mainEntity.name: Will I definitely be prescribed medication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. Medication is considered when clinically appropriate, but we also offer practical strategies, behavioural interventions, and therapeutic options. The treatment plan is personalized based on your specific needs, preferences, and clinical assessment.

mainEntity.name: Do you provide therapy or only medication management?

acceptedAnswer.text: The clinic offers psychiatric consultations and counselling support. Depending on your needs, the clinician may discuss therapy, practical strategies, medication, or referral to another professional.

mainEntity.name: How do I book an appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the booking form, call +91 96678 63295, or send a WhatsApp message. The clinic aims to respond within 24–48 hours using the contact method you provide; this is not an emergency service.
Fees can vary by consultation type. Please check the fees page for the current information or contact the clinic before booking if you need clarification.

Please confirm coverage directly with your insurer before your visit. Ask the clinic whether the available receipt or documentation can support your particular claim; reimbursement depends on your policy.

mainEntity.name: How much does a psychiatric consultation cost at Mind Grace in Greater Noida?

acceptedAnswer.text: An initial psychiatric consultation with Dr. Anita Sharma costs ₹900 for a 45-minute session. If the consultation runs beyond one hour, every additional 15 minutes is charged at ₹200.

mainEntity.name: What do therapy sessions at Aasha cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Therapy and counselling sessions cost ₹1,000 for a 45-minute session. If multiple sessions are required or you can't afford the standard rates, come and talk to us at the reception — mental health should be affordable by all. mainEntity.name: How much do psychological assessments and testing cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: Psychological assessment fees vary based on scope and are quoted after an initial screening to determine the appropriate assessment battery. Common assessments include IQ testing, ADHD evaluation, autism spectrum assessment, and personality inventories, with a typical range of ₹2,000 to ₹8,000 depending on complexity.

mainEntity.name: What payment methods does Mind Grace Neuropsychiatric Clinic accept?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mind Grace accepts cash at the clinic, UPI payments via QR code or UPI ID with instant confirmation and digital receipt, and NEFT/IMPS bank transfers (transaction ID required for confirmation). Itemized invoices are provided for insurance reimbursement or tax documentation.
